credentials: PHD 2020 Univ of Maryland College Park
name: RUYUN FENG

ratings.comment: I would recommend Ivy to everyone. She cares so much about her students and is constantly asking feedback for improving our experience. Her lectures are hard, but she provides a lot of practice material so you feel prepared going into exams.
She made the class harder than other lecturers, so we were better prepared for exams. Gives out lots of practice problems too

Ivy was a great professor this semester. She cared about her students, made herself available for any/all questions, and was extremely knowledgeable and passionate about Accounting. While 301 is known to be a difficult course, she made it digestable and enjoyable. I could not reccomend her more!

Ivy is an understanding professor who clearly wants the best for her students. She often asked for feedback and was always willing to explain problems or help students out. The tests were hard and the lectures were sometimes rushed, but there was a generous curve and Ivy went out of her way to prepare for tests and cover all problems.

Ivy is fantastic. She puts a lot of effort into helping us as best she can. She tailored her lecture style to what we wanted (she polled us), explains things very clearly, and provides clear answers to practice problems. She's not here to trick you. I love her work stories too.

This is a hard class, and I think it would be hard with any professor. Ivy will help you work through things, but you have to be sure to reach out and ask for help. I felt that we sometimes got distracted and wasted time during lecture, but she makes up for it by posting detailed walk-throughs of hard problems which were super helpful.
Despite the difficulty of this course, Ivy does everything she can to help her students succeed. Ivy is also very knowledgeable of the subject matter and is extremely organized.

Acct 301 is a hard class. Ivy helps those who are looking for it. Very helpful and accessible outside of class, but make sure you reach out to her. Offers good advice about which problems will be on the exam as long as you attend her review sessions.

She is great. Pretty knowledgeable about both finance and accounting. Really cares about her students and very accessible! Responds to emails in real time. Offers periodic reviews and review sessions before the exam that are super helpful! Exams are hard but I was told that the practice exam and exams are the same across all instructors...

Ivy doesn't help students at all. After the first exam, she told us not to email her asking to see the exams because she didn't want to spend time going over them. She doesn't teach what's in the book but we're still expected to read it. Exams are nothing like the practice exam which is why they're so hard. Do not take a class with her!!
